message.content: {"caption":"Two side-by-side scatter plots compare task-goal completion with model size on AppWorld and BFCL v3, including AgentEvolver and Qwen model variants.","description":"A two-panel scatter chart has Model Size on the horizontal axis, with ticks at 7B, 14B, 30B, 100B, and 235B, and Task Goal Completion (%) on the vertical axis. AppWorld has y-axis ticks from 0 to 50 in steps of 10; BFCL v3 has ticks from 20 to 70 in steps of 10. Each point is labeled with its model name. The Qwen models use colored circular marks; AgentEvolver-7B and AgentEvolver-14B are marked by blue dolphin logos, which denote AgentEvolver. Values below are approximate visual read-offs. In AppWorld, AgentEvolver-7B is about 31% and AgentEvolver-14B about 49%; the 14B model is highest, while the 7B model exceeds most Qwen points but is below the Qwen 2.5-32B and Qwen3-32B points. In BFCL v3, AgentEvolver-7B is about 57% and AgentEvolver-14B about 69%; the 14B model is highest, and the 7B model is below the 235B Qwen3 point but above the other Qwen points.
